claims.text: Muir is at the centre of the Halifax waterfront, in the heart of the new Queen's Marque district.

findings.quote: Muir is at the very centre of the dynamic Halifax Waterfront in the heart of the new Queen's Marque district.

claims.text: The Queen's Marque district offers access to the Atlantic Ocean and a multi-million-dollar public art collection.

findings.quote: The district offers unprecedented access to the Atlantic Ocean, a multi-million-dollar public art collection

claims.text: Scheduled excursions on Reach, the hotel's high-speed 24-foot motorboat, explore the bays and coves of Halifax's historic harbour.

findings.quote: Feel the salt spray and ocean wind on your skin on our high-speed 24-foot motorboat, Reach. Exclusive scheduled excursions and tours will explore the dozens of bays and coves throughout Halifax's historic harbour.

claims.text: Kayaks and bicycles are available to make use of the hotel's direct water access.

findings.quote: Make the most of Muir's unprecedented location and direct water access with our kayaks and bicycles.

claims.text: True Colours, the private guest art gallery, hosts regular gallery talks and intimate events.

findings.quote: Art at Muir is brought to life in True Colours, a private art gallery exclusively for our guests.
True Colours invites guests to deeply connect with the exhibits through regular gallery talks and intimate events.

claims.text: Guests find a significant collection of local and global art throughout the hotel.

findings.quote: Proudly profiled within our rooms, common areas, outdoor spaces and throughout the Queens Marque district, guests will find a significant collection of local and global art

claims.text: Rooms have furniture and lighting designed and crafted in Canada, curved white oak walls and walnut-panelled flooring.

findings.quote: custom furniture and lighting designed and crafted in Canada, lighting and drapery with custom dimming options and rooms with curved white oak walls and walnut-panelled flooring.

claims.text: Rooms have triple-paned soundproofed windows with bedside-controlled blackout drapes.

findings.quote: Triple-paned sound-proofed windows with bedside controlled blackout drapes and lighting

claims.text: The Shannon and Thrumcap Suites were designed by Canada's Studio Munge and include a living room and dining area.

findings.quote: the Shannon and Thrumcap Suites offer immediate ocean views. These spacious suites feature a finely-appointed living room, dining area and walnut bar. Designed by Canada’s Studio Munge

claims.text: Drift serves modern, elevated takes on classic Atlantic Canadian dishes.

findings.quote: Drift features modern, elevated takes on classic Atlantic Canadian dishes.

claims.text: Muir offers car and driver service with a hybrid Range Rover.

findings.quote: car and driver service with hybrid Range Rover and valet parking

claims.text: Little Wing, Muir's 36-foot Morris yacht, gives guests a view of the coastline from the water.

findings.quote: From Little Wing, Muir's 36-foot Morris yacht, guests will get a rare perspective of this much-loved coastline.

claims.text: The Watch, the presidential suite, juts over Halifax harbour with ocean views on three sides.

findings.quote: Presidential Suite, 1 King, Water view
Jutting dramatically over the Halifax harbour with ocean views on three sides, The Watch is a unique Canadian experience.

claims.text: True Colours is a private art gallery for hotel guests with a rotating collection of exhibits.

findings.quote: True Colours, a private art gallery exclusively for our guests. Explore a rotating collection of exhibits that speak to a distinct sense of place.

claims.text: Windward Wellness includes a fitness centre, spin and yoga studio, exercise classes, vitality spa pool, cold plunge pool, halotherapy salt room, eucalyptus steam room and infrared sauna.

findings.quote: Access to Windward Wellness, including ultra-premium fitness centre, spin and yoga studio, exercise classes, vitality spa pool, cold plunge pool, halotherapy salt room, eucalyptus steam room and infrared sauna.

claims.text: All rooms and suites feature Aesop bath products, custom-made furnishings, original Nova Scotia landscape paintings and ceramics, and a handcrafted walnut bar.

findings.quote: all rooms and suites feature Aesop bath products, custom-made furnishings, original Nova Scotia landscape paintings and ceramics, and a handcrafted walnut bar.

claims.text: Rollaway beds are not permitted, and the largest-occupancy room, the Signature Double Queen, sleeps a maximum of three.

findings.quote: No, the rooms at Muir, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Halifax do not permit rollaway beds.
The largest occupancy room at Muir, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Halifax is the Signature Double Queen with a maximum occupancy of 3.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the urban setting may not suit guests seeking a secluded retreat.
